categories.main_business_segments: Tuhu Car Inc. operates as an integrated online and offline automotive service platform in China, offering automotive products and services including tires, chassis parts, auto maintenance, quick repairs, car detailing, and beauty services. It also provides franchise services, advertising services, and operates a supply chain platform named Qipeilong for auto parts sales to workshops and third-party dealers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital platforms such as its flagship Tuhu Automotive Service APP and online interfaces to streamline automotive service demands. It employs AI technologies for intelligent customer service and operational efficiency, automated warehouse management with light-guided picking, and develops private label products through partnerships with manufacturers. The company also emphasizes standardized quality inspection systems and digitalized supply chain and logistics management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tuhu primarily serves individual car owners across China, including owners of new energy vehicles (NEVs), hybrid vehicles, and traditional passenger vehicles. It also serves franchised workshops, partner stores, and third-party auto parts dealers. The company targets both higher-tier and lower-tier cities, with a focus on expanding automotive service accessibility nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 32 provincial-level administrative regions, 318 prefectural-level administrative regions, and 1,759 county-level administrative divisions. It has full coverage in several provinces including Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Chongqing, Hainan, Tibet, and Tianjin, and a significant presence in Guangdong Province with over 1,000 stores.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tuhu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive service supply chain. It acts as a principal in product sales and service delivery, managing inventory, logistics, and fulfillment through its own and franchised workshops. It also operates an upstream supply platform (Qipeilong) for auto parts procurement and distribution to workshops and dealers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on digital transformation, AI integration, and supply chain optimization to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. It invests in R&D for product innovation, including private label tire and engine oil development, NEV-specific maintenance solutions, and hybrid vehicle products. Tuhu also emphasizes standardization, quality assurance, and environmental sustainability in its innovation initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Tuhu generates revenue mainly through direct sales of automotive products and services to individual customers, franchise fees from franchised workshops, advertising services on its platforms, and sales of auto parts via its Qipeilong supply chain platform. Revenue is recognized at the point of product/service delivery or over time for franchise and advertising services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tuhu is positioned as the market leader in China's independent automotive service market by revenue, with a strong brand presence and the largest network of automotive service workshops nationwide. It competes with other automotive service providers and platforms but differentiates itself through its integrated online-offline model, extensive store network, and digital capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tuhu reported revenue of RMB14.8 billion, an 8.5% increase from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 25.4%. The company achieved adjusted net profit growth of 29.7% to RMB624 million and maintained a strong cash position exceeding RMB7.5 billion. It operates 6,874 workshops and serves 24.1 million transacting users, demonstrating steady growth and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tuhu offers customers a comprehensive, convenient, and value-for-money automotive service experience through its integrated digital platform and extensive offline workshop network. It emphasizes authentic products, professional services, competitive pricing, and standardized quality assurance. The company’s innovation in AI-driven customer service, private label products, and NEV-specific services further differentiates its offerings.
